question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"trained."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Trained"** is the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3. • This verb means to teach or prepare someone for a particular task or skill. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को कठिन या अभ्‍यास की अपेक्षा वाला काम सिखाना, प्रशिक्षण देना) • **Example:** *She **trained**__ as an engineer.* • The correct answer is option 4. • Correct passage: The Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (DISHA) or National Digital Literacy Mission (NDLM) Scheme has been formulated to __impart__ IT training to 52.5 lakh persons, including Anganwadi and ASHA workers and authorised ration dealers in all the States/UTS __across__ the country so that the non-IT literate citizens are __**trained**__ to become IT literate so as to ______ (4) ______ them to actively and effectively participate in the democratic and developmental process and also ______ (5) ______ their livelihood. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Included"** means to have something as part of a group or set. (को समाविष्‍ट करना; साथ में रखना) • **Example: ***The package included a free trial of the product.* • **"Made"** means to create or produce something. (कुछ उत्‍पन्‍न या सृजित करना) • **Example:** *The chef made a delicious meal for her guests.* • **"Ordered"** means to request or command something to be done. (आदेश, आज्ञा या हुक्‍म देना) • **Example: ***The customer ordered a pizza for delivery.* 45:Tebd, The correct answer is **"enable."**
